1329-3363-5315.easyPrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-3363-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing The One Ring, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast The One Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1417-3249-4474--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1417-3249-4474--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Bridge from Below triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

654-2608-2882-3899-6644.manaNeeded: {G}{W}{U} plus an additional {1} if you've cast Derevi from the command zone this game
654-2608-2882-3899-6644.description:
If you haven't cast Derevi from the command zone this game, cast it by paying {G}{W}{U}. Otherwise, activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Derevi enters the battlefield as a copy of Ancient Adamantoise due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Derevi.
Choose to return Derevi from your graveyard to the command zone.
When Derevi dies, it triggers, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{W}{U}.
Repeat.

1170-2350-3698-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2350-3698-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stone Calendar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

394-586-864-3125-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-586-864-3125-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Desecrated Tomb.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-4094-4826-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

3532-5078-5705-7864.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2122-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1086-1895-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Anointer Priest trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1086-1895-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3558-3652-5860-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
3558-3652-5860-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1169-4613-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
1169-4613-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped, does not have summoning sickness, and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1169-4613-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

2099-4907-6747-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
2099-4907-6747-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

1456-2478-4195-4574.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

804-2760-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Sakashima the Impostor.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1069-2457-3499-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-3499-5499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

3525-5268-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

4869-5014-6092.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
4869-5014-6092.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Repeat.

333-997-5617.notablePrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-997-5617.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1652-2034-5258-5618.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Patron of the Arts, adding {C}{C}.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Patron of the Arts trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Patron of the Arts from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling three cards from the top of your library, including Patron of the Arts, with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Cast Patron of the Arts from exile by paying {3}.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1308-2038-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Kozilek's Predator.
When Kozilek's Predator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

539-2092-4385-4552.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {0}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Repeat.

851-1651-2561-4798.description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, creating two Food tokens.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Ovalchase Daredevil twice, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Repeat.

4091-4639.notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
4091-4639.description:
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Aphetto Alchemist triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

1283-1684-2034-2178.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1283-1684-2034-2178.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {1} and tapping it to create an Elemental token with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental token, adding {C}{C}.
Rakka Mar triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
